payload.title: This 345-million-year-old fossil had scientists fooled for decades
payload.summary: A famous 345-million-year-old fossil has turned out to be something entirely different from what scientists believed for decades. Advanced X-ray imaging revealed hidden gills and thousands of tiny teeth, exposing a primitive aquatic or amphibious creature rather than an early reptile. The discovery suggests that several adaptations associated with life on land actually evolved in animals still dependent on water.
